column1: # Hand transcription of every dyama/alpr_jp plate crop (alpr_jp is MIT; the images stay at their source).
# Read by `jlpr train --alpr-labels` and `tools/train_ocr.py --alpr-labels`; without it the real crops
# teach the region head only (from the folder name) and the 553 crops filed without a region folder
# key     <category>/<region>/<file> (region folders) or <category>/<file> (自家用(軽)/ 事業用/ 事業用(軽)/)
# region  empty = the folder's name; a name = what the plate actually shows (2 Nagasaki plates are
#         filed under 自家用/大分/); ? = not readable (region head masked)
# ? (whole field or one character) = not readable: only that head is masked.
